from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonCurrentAssetLineItem(BaseModel):
    """One line-item component of non-current assets."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written in the balance sheet")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount for this line item")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit for this line item: 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")

class CompanyNonCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """Non-current assets information from one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the filing")
    total_non_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="The total non-current assets amount reported")
    total_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit for the total: 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., quarter ended March 31, 2024)")
    line_items: list[NonCurrentAssetLineItem] = Field(description="Component line items that make up non-current assets")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the non-current assets information")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_non_current_assets: list[CompanyNonCurrentAssets]
